summary.intent: Plan, execute, and ship phase 63 ('read-chain-navigation-and-rotation-core') of CipherBox — covering read-grant issuance, navigation walk, rotation engine, folder mutations, and a live sdk-e2e round-trip.
summary.outcome: Phase 63 fully planned (7 plans, 4 waves, plan-checker PASSED iteration 2, 7/7 requirements + 10/10 decisions covered), executed (all 7 plans, ~25 commits, 0 regressions), verified (5/5 must-haves), and marked complete in tracking files. /ship-phase 63 (PR creation) was not reached within the transcript.

repo: sdk-core has no `typecheck` npm script; the real type gate is `build` which runs `tsup && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json`. Plans 63-05 and 63-06 referenced a nonexistent `typecheck` script.
API health endpoint is port 3000 `/health`; CI polls with `curl -fsS http://localhost:3000/health` in a bounded loop — use this pattern instead of `sleep N` in e2e setup.
The GSD commit helper consistently reports false 'needs human verification' warnings on successful commits — git log is the authoritative check.
Worktrees are contraindicated in this repo (documented node_modules and api:generate leaks). Sequential main-tree execution is the safe default for phases with shared test files.
commitlint and release-please dislike parenthetical references in commit subject descriptions (e.g. `(READ-01)`, `(D-03 SC#3)`) — 5 commits in this phase have this pattern.
Weekly API usage limit resets at 7am Europe/Berlin. When a subagent hits the limit, atomic commit discipline means the tree is always clean at the interruption boundary.
`addShareKeys` callback TYPE in `packages/sdk/src/types.ts:32` is intentionally preserved through Phase 68 per locked decision D-03 — not dead code.
The live sdk-e2e round-trip (63-07) caught a real BFS bug in engine.ts: child `rotateOne` calls were receiving the root's new readKey instead of each child's own derived readKey.

code.finding: `issueReadGrant`: single `wrapKey` call, zero IPNS/node operations, transport-decoupled `insertShareFn`. Tests assert `wrapKey` called exactly once and no resolve/seal mock invoked.

`navigateReadChain`: single `unwrapKey` (ECIES), then O(depth) loop over `unsealChildReadKey` using `childRef.generation` (parent-mirror, not child envelope — the critical generation-source rule). Returns `'ok' | 'behind-retry' | 'revoked'` string-literal union.
Named file (not index.ts), 558 lines. Contains 4 Phase-64 seams as named functions throwing `'not implemented — phase 64 (...)'`, invoked conditionally so the clean happy path never triggers them.
`hasCoveringGrant` is a pure function (zero I/O). Zero-rotation invariant (SC#4) is proven by spy in scope.test.ts L134-146.
`addShareKeys` callback TYPE intentionally preserved for Phase 68 boundary per locked decision D-03.

Had 4 stale `describe.skip('...TODO(phase 63)')` blocks at L114, L257, L454, L878 testing the retired `FolderChild`/`encryptFolderMetadata` API under `@ts-nocheck`. All deleted in cleanup commit `6a739a20a`; conflict/CAS tests migrated to `cas.test.ts`.

workflow: Always run a second plan-checker iteration after self-fixing checker findings rather than marking them resolved inline — keeps the gate honest.
When a usage limit hits mid-phase, check tree state before doing anything. Atomic subagent commits leave a clean resume point; verify with git status before retrying.
Delegate large stale-test block removal to a focused subagent rather than editing inline — reduces orchestrator context pollution and risk of touching adjacent live tests.
The VALIDATION.md per-task map should be filled during planning (step 5.5 body), not left as a template — the plan-checker will flag it as a blocker.
RESEARCH.md `## Open Questions` must be marked `(RESOLVED)` after answers are incorporated — the checker treats unresolved open questions as a blocker.
Non-blocking drift gate at plan time: a stale `.planning/codebase/` map doesn't block planning when CONTEXT.md and RESEARCH.md carry verified implementation-site references.

friction: Weekly usage limit hit mid-wave-3 (63-06) at ~07:00 Berlin, interrupting the subagent. Required a timed retry after reset.
GSD commit helper consistently emits false 'needs human verification' on successful commits — required manual `git log` verification after every commit step, adding friction throughout.
Plans 63-05 and 63-06 referenced a `typecheck` npm script that doesn't exist in sdk-core; executor had to redirect to `build` mid-execution.

Plan-checker required a second iteration: 1 blocker (RESEARCH.md open questions unmarked) and 2 warnings (VALIDATION.md template unfilled, fragile `sleep 12` in 63-07) needed fixes before verification passed.
Drift gate flagged a stale codebase map early in planning, adding noise even though it was non-blocking.
